title: I got banned for griefing

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello,

You have many previous infractions for team grief (https://gyazo.com/7e519d102ec4e8c3430f700c8a20df83), three of which occurred within the previous ten days before your ban. This suggests that your infraction is valid, and shows that you continued to break rules after being told not to numerous times. Please wait until your ban is expired, and do not create another appeal. Your appeal is denied.
 
Regards,
Rinn
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
